verdict.rationale: The docs describe an AI agent driving a real iPhone through an ESP32 acting as an AirPlay receiver and mouse, with no computer or jailbreak needed. The user types a plain-language goal and presses Start, and a worked example has the agent opening Clock, typing a time, ticking days and saving. Replays draw the taps and swipes on screen, the pointer self-calibrates via AssistiveTouch, and runs resume after link drops. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; all evidence is first-party README material.
